description: Reusable authored-pose direction for martial artist player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies disciplined empty-hand form choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: disciplined, athletic, crisp, balanced, and technically exact, with visible chambering, hip rotation, guard recovery, and bare-fist footwork
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's gi, headband, belt, wraps, jewelry, and exact accessory count. Keep both empty hands visible when the portrait is unarmed; never invent a weapon, duplicate wraps, or change belt and headband design.
identity.magicRule: Martial artistry is entirely physical. Do not add ki aura, elemental trails, runes, projectiles, or supernatural afterimages; a tiny contact accent may mark a real strike.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, headband, gi, belt, wraps, palette, proportions, and accessories. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact athletic full-body silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered martial artist in a technically precise fighting stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall martial artist motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, gi, headband, belt, wraps, palette, proportions, and empty-hand continuity. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A calm guard loop shifts stance height, breath, lead-hand distance, and rear-foot pressure while maintaining technical alignment.
idle.effectRule: No active effect; headband, gi, and belt ends respond subtly to breath.
frameDescriptions: precise empty-hand fighting guard
measured inhale as guard rises
weight shifts onto the forward leg
lead hand tests distance while rear hand protects
centered balanced midpoint
controlled exhale lowering the stance
weight shifts onto the rear foot
precise guard flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A light alternating advance uses forefoot contacts, real knee compression, smooth passing steps, disciplined guard, and gi follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No magic or attack trail; cloth and headband respond to the footwork.
frameDescriptions: left forefoot forward contact behind raised guard
left knee compresses with hips level
passing pose as right knee advances
right foot reaches while hands preserve guard
right forefoot forward contact
right knee compresses with balanced posture
passing pose as left knee advances
left foot reaches into the guarded loop

attack.motionDirection: A lead-hand measure becomes a rear-hand punch, hip-loaded kick chamber, full turning kick, controlled landing, and immediate guard recovery.
attack.effectRule: One tiny physical contact accent may mark the punch or kick; no aura, trail, afterimage, or hidden limbs.
frameDescriptions: technical guard measuring distance
lead hand extends while rear fist chambers
rear-hand punch drives through rotating hips
weight transfers as the kicking knee chambers high
full turning-kick extension with arms counterbalancing
controlled retraction and landing
hands and feet rebuild the guard
recovered precise fighting stance

hurt.motionDirection: A clean hit breaks alignment into a flinch, maximum stagger, rolling backward step, low guard catch, technical rise, and stance reset.
hurt.effectRule: One compact physical impact accent only; no gore, blood, aura, or full-body tint.
frameDescriptions: precise guard before impact
sharp articulated flinch with forearms closing
maximum stagger with torso turned and knees bent
rolling backward step to absorb force
low balanced catch behind a tight guard
technical push upright from the legs
feet reset to correct stance width
recovered focused guard

death.motionDirection: A final blow breaks stance alignment, knees buckle, one hand catches the descent, the body rolls sideways, and settles fully fallen.
death.effectRule: No gore, blood, magic, or rigid rotation; keep gi, headband, wraps, and limbs clearly articulated.
frameDescriptions: fatal impact breaks the fighting guard
arms slacken as balance fails
knees buckle into a low drop
one hand catches the floor as hips turn
body rolls into full ground contact
gi, limbs, and headband settle low
final fully fallen martial artist
same final fallen pose held

victory.motionDirection: The martial artist confirms victory, bows, executes a compact palm-and-kick kata, lands cleanly, closes both fists, and holds a formal finish.
victory.effectRule: No magic; motion is carried by anatomy, gi, belt, and headband follow-through.
